tooltip.netmusic_airwaves.radio_modulato: Plays a NetMusic CD and broadcasts it through a cabled Airwaves transmitter.
No GUI. Right-click with a CD to load it. Empty-hand click ejects a disc. Sneak + empty-hand click toggles shift-eject mode. A redstone pulse toggles playback.
tooltip.netmusic_airwaves.spectrum_monit: A NetMusic disc player with a playlist GUI and a live spectrum display.
Empty-hand click opens the spectrum deck GUI. Right-click with a CD to load it fast. A redstone pulse toggles playback.
message.netmusic_airwaves.no_cd: There is no NetMusic CD in this slot.
message.netmusic_airwaves.need_vip: This VIP song needs a working NetMusic URL resolver.
message.netmusic_airwaves.no_cable: Connect this deck to an Airwaves transmitter with a cable.
message.netmusic_airwaves.no_connected_t: The cable is connected, but there is no Airwaves transmitter on the other end.
message.netmusic_airwaves.transmitter_of: The connected Airwaves transmitter is not active.

gui.netmusic_airwaves.mode.hint: Toggle shift-eject mode: the first slot is the input and the last the output; middle slots are locked to hoppers (the GUI can still move discs freely). When a disc finishes, the queue shifts one slot toward the output.
